Logistics & Courier Coverage

Kerala-Wide Delivery Information

✦ ✦ ✦

Achar & Co. is proud to serve families, foodies, and event caterers across all 14 revenue districts of Kerala. Here is how our doorstep courier system operates.

🗺️

14 Districts Served

From the southern tip of Parassala (Thiruvananthapuram) to the northern coast of Manjeshwar (Kasaragod), we deliver through leading domestic express and parcel couriers.

⚖️

Transparent Courier Charges

Because heavy glass jars require protective shock-absorbing cushioning, courier charges vary by parcel weight and specific pincode. We quote exact courier fees on WhatsApp before you pay.

⏱️

Estimated Dispatch Timelines

Fresh batches are packed upon order confirmation. Most Kerala locations receive their parcel within 2 to 4 working days of dispatch. We share live courier tracking on WhatsApp.

Active Delivery Districts

Click on your district to enquiry via WhatsApp regarding delivery rates and next available dispatch:

* Note: Delivery to remote high-range taluks in Idukki and Wayanad may require an additional day depending on postal route access.
